name: performance
title: Performance
summary: Budgets that can be measured from the built output. Lab metrics such as Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals need a browser, so they are reported as unavailable rather than assumed.
source: docs/v2-inputs.md — 'Features to have in a website', performance items

items.requirement: No shipped image exceeds 300KB; compress and use modern formats
At most two font families, loaded with font-display: swap
Images declare width and height so layout does not shift
items.source: _base.md base.perf.images; features #24 — improve core web vitals

items.requirement: Images below the fold are lazy-loaded
Defer non-critical scripts rather than blocking render
Mobile Lighthouse: LCP under 2.5s, CLS under 0.1, INP under 200ms
Serve static assets from a CDN with cache headers
